method: tiles decoded (public1f/mvt.py), fragments merged per (layer, floor, mid); lon/lat -> local metres (equirectangular at LAT0, LON0) -> rigid 2D fit (no scale) of Naver shop vertices to the 16 built unit polygons of first-floor-plan.json (same mid), ICP vertex matching < 2 u

transform.localMetres: x = rad(lon-lon0)*R*cos(lat0), z = rad(lat-lat0)*R; pre-UV (x sin16.2 + z cos16.2, x cos16.2 - z sin16.2); UV = matrix @ pre + translation
